hub.title: Finance
hub.noAccessDescription: Finance is available to Finance, Executive and Admin roles.
hub.bucketHelp: How this age balance is calculated
hub.receivablesHint: Sum of known outstanding balances on open invoices, including tax. Draft and cancelled invoices are excluded.
hub.payablesHint: Unpaid supplier invoice balances (invoice amount less payments made), grouped by currency. Unknown balances are counted, not added.
hub.reportsHint: Earned revenue minus invoiced revenue through the latest selected month, before tax.
hub.statementsHint: Net profit from the latest available company profit and loss statement period.
hub.receivableBucketHint: Known outstanding balances grouped by days past due. Not yet due includes balances due today or later.
hub.payableBucketHint: Known unpaid supplier balances grouped by calendar days since the invoice was recorded. Invoices with an unknown balance are counted in their age group, not added.
hub.finding: {{overdue}} overdue across {{count}} invoices{{oldest}} · {{payables}} to pay suppliers
hub.invoiceBalanceHint: Known ERP outstanding amount in the invoice currency, including tax.
hub.draftsApproveHint: Count of draft invoices that you can approve.
hub.draftsSecondHint: Count of your draft invoices that need another approver.
hub.notReceivedHint: Count of active invoices with no received date recorded.
hub.unappliedHint: Count and known unapplied amounts for active receipts.
hub.waitingPayablesHint: Count, total amount and age of supplier invoices recorded and still waiting to be paid.
hub.oldestPayableHint: Calendar days since the supplier invoice was recorded, using the oldest payable invoice.
hub.noPayables: No supplier invoices waiting to be paid.
hub.payablesTable: Supplier invoices waiting to be paid

area.receivablesMeaning_one: owed to you · {{count}} invoice · tax included
area.receivablesMeaning_other: owed to you · {{count}} invoices · tax included

statements.noStatement: Net profit is not available for a period yet
statements.source: Statements come from the accounting system.
statements.askAdmin: Statements come from the accounting system; an Admin sets this up in Integrations.

waiting.draftsSecond_one: {{count}} draft waiting for a second approver
waiting.draftsSecond_other: {{count}} drafts waiting for a second approver
waiting.payables_one: {{count}} supplier invoice waiting to be paid
waiting.payables_other: {{count}} supplier invoices waiting to be paid

payables.oldestMeaning: Calendar days since the supplier invoice was recorded
payables.unknownNote_one: {{count}} invoice has no amount and is left out of the total
payables.unknownNote_other: {{count}} invoices have no amount and are left out of the total

hub.payableBucketBasis: Calendar days since invoiced status was recorded, or last update if unavailable. Unknown balances are counted, not added.
hub.helpAges: Client balances by age count days past due, tax included. Waiting to pay counts days since the supplier invoice was recorded, or last updated.
hub.payablesHelp: Waiting to pay counts calendar days since the supplier invoice was recorded, or since its last update when no date was recorded. Procurement shows the invoice's own age, a different clock.

managementPack.noSearchMatchesSub: Try another project, client or project manager name.
managementPack.unassignedNote: Some invoices are not assigned to a project yet.

figures.title: Report figures
figures.earnedNotInvoicedHelp: Earned to date minus invoiced to date, using the report’s revenue recognition basis.
figures.earnedToDateHelp: Cumulative recognized revenue through the as-at month; the subline shows this month’s change.
figures.invoicedToDateHelp: Cumulative dated invoice value and invoice count through the as-at month.
figures.backlogHelp: Contract total minus revenue earned to date; unavailable if a foreign-currency invoice needs reconciliation.

managementPack.noProgressNote: No progress is recorded yet, so earned revenue follows what has been invoiced.
managementPack.backlogUnknownNote: Backlog is left out where a foreign-currency invoice needs reconciliation before the balance can be known.

draftReview.title: Review and activate drafts
draftReview.hint: Check each draft against its source, tick the ones to activate, then confirm once. Each draft is activated and recorded on its own.
draftReview.notAllowed: Someone else must activate this draft
draftReview.soleOperator: You're the only person in this organisation, so you can activate budgets you prepared yourself. Once a colleague joins, a second person will need to activate them.
draftReview.erpNotUpdated: {{count}} activated but ERPNext was not updated; ask Finance or an administrator to review it.
draftReview.blockedEditor: You drafted or edited this draft, so someone else must activate it.
draftReview.needsAdminFinance: No drafter is recorded, so only Admin or Finance can activate this draft.
draftReview.eligibilityUnavailable: Activation eligibility is unavailable. Refresh this page and try again.
draftReview.distributionMissing: Save a fiscal-year distribution on the project's Budget tab first.
draftReview.distributionStale: The saved fiscal-year distribution no longer matches this draft. Review it on the project's Budget tab.
draftReview.confirmBody_one: This makes {{count}} draft (total {{total}}) the live active budget of its project and supersedes that project’s current active version. It is activated and recorded on its own.
draftReview.confirmBody_other: This makes {{count}} drafts (total {{total}}) the live active budgets of their projects and supersedes each project’s current active version. Each is activated and recorded on its own; one refusal does not stop the others.
draftReview.activatedErpFailed: Activated, but ERPNext was not updated
draftReview.activatedNothingSent: Activated, but nothing was sent to ERPNext: no budget lines
draftReview.nothingSent: {{count}} activated but nothing was sent to ERPNext (no budget lines); add lines and activate a new version to enforce one.
draftReview.activatedErpPending: Activated, ERPNext update queued behind an earlier cancellation
draftReview.erpPushQueued: {{count}} activated with the ERPNext push queued behind an earlier budget cancellation; it is pushed automatically once that settles.
